confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Athens price levels for July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable, while July hostel and hotel rates vary widely by district and demand, so accommodation is least certain. EUR figures assume roughly 1.15 USD per EUR (my approximation, not searched). Cocktail is set near 2x draft beer and wine glass near 1.1x beer as a cross-check where direct knowledge is weaker. The FX value came from search results citing the RBA daily table; I did not open that table directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southern European capital cities with similar summer tourist demand (for example Lisbon), adjusted to Athens' moderate restaurant and hotel price levels.
